// Maps for the FX chip. Made by tools/mapconv.py from the Tiled maps in Assets/Maps. Do not edit.
// mapList: count, then the address of each map record.
// A map record: width, height, block columns, block rows, building count, address of the block table,
// name (12 bytes, zero padded), then one byte per tile row by row (top frame + 1 in the high 4 bits, 0 for none,
// terrain kind in the low 4 bits), then per diagonal c+r the index of its first building (width + height - 1 bytes),
// then 7 bytes per building, back to front: column, row, kind + 16 * start owner,
// picture x and y on the map picture (int16). The block table holds one uint16 per 64x64 block
// (index in mapBlocks, draw frame index * 3 + layer), row by row.
